PRODUCT CATEGORY

Special-Shape Sponges

Special-shape sponges cover shapes beyond the standard rectangle, designed for different grip and surface-contact needs.

Oval, butterfly and specially cut shapes for bath and body care, car care, and home and kitchen use offer options in which the product's shape can be chosen to suit how it is used.
